The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items.The tender fees of Rs. 1,000/- (nonrefundable) is to be paid through DD/ Pay order favoring Secretary, Kasturba Health Society on any nationalised bank payable at Sevagram. Tender forms can be obtained from the office of Head of Engineering Mantainance Department, KHS, Sevagram between 10.00 am to 5.00 p.m. on all working days.
KHS reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
